method: two observed discharge boundaries (LJJ 86472000 + Passo Carreiro 86500000) + residual rainfall-runoff + E28 routing

observed_network_audit.rain_spatial_method: IDW^2 por hora em grade 0.05° sobre a bacia e zonas HEC; usa todos os postos com observação válida; ausência permanece ausente, nunca zero

antas_branch_state.note: all fresh Q gauges constrain branch trend; nested gauges are diagnostics, never added as independent flows

carreiro_branch_state.note: all fresh Q gauges constrain branch trend; nested gauges are diagnostics, never added as independent flows

observed_network_audit.rule: all observed gauges are used for QC/state/trend; only non-overlapping downstream branch controls are added to mass balance

rna_reference_not_assimilated.note: RNA values are validation references only and do not enter HEC forcing or calibration.

routing_sweep.selection_rule: min |t0 stage error| + 0.45*RMSE6h + 0.15*|bias6h| + 0.80*|current slope error| using current-event observations
routing_sweep.note: Only routing is recalibrated; observed rain and observed discharge states are unchanged.
